When did marketing get so hard?
More and more content needed, across more and more channels, with too many partners, and not enough budget. 
We make it simple.
Halo
Make AI-powered content your competitive advantage.
Every brand needs to produce 
better, faster, cheaper content
. Traditionally, you could only choose two. Now, with ITG’s global production model, powered by Storyteq, you can have all three — without compromise. 
 
We help our clients realize AI’s full potential by transforming their marketing operations to deliver scaled Halo content that drives growth, cuts costs, and creates the perfect story for every customer interaction. We do this across four key pillars:
Capture
Create
Automate
Integrate
AI-powered film & photography
Create more content for less budget at our state-of-the-art studios.
Learn more
Your Halo content partner for marketing transformation.
As the Halo content partner to global brands, we deliver AI-powered, agile content that drives growth, cuts costs, and creates the perfect story for every customer interaction.
Discover Halo
The 
only AI-powered Content Marketing Platform
 that brings together strategic intelligence, digital asset management, creative automation and content production workflows — so teams can 
produce better performing content, faster, that is always on brand.
Discover Storyteq
